SPARKLINE COMMERCIAL CLEANING — Keep Your Workplace Spotless

Sparkline Commercial Cleaning has served the Brandon business district for over fifteen years. We provide nightly office cleaning, carpet shampooing, window washing, and floor waxing for offices, clinics, and retail spaces of all sizes.

June Special: Sign a twelve-month service agreement before June 30 and receive your first month of nightly cleaning at half price. This offer applies to new clients only and cannot be combined with any other promotion. A minimum cleaning area of 200 square meters is required to qualify.

All Sparkline staff are bonded and insured, and we use only certified eco-friendly cleaning products. Weekend service is available for an additional 15 percent surcharge. Please note that we do not service residential properties or industrial kitchens.

For a free on-site estimate, call 555-0142 or visit www.sparklineclean.com. Estimates are typically scheduled within two business days.

NOW HIRING: Evening Cleaning Crew Supervisor

Sparkline Commercial Cleaning is seeking a full-time supervisor to lead a five-person evening crew serving office buildings in central Brandon. The supervisor assigns nightly tasks, inspects completed work, maintains supply inventories, and reports directly to the operations manager.

Requirements:
- At least two years of commercial cleaning experience
- A valid driver's license, as the supervisor transports equipment between sites in a company van
- Availability from 6:00 P.M. to 2:30 A.M., Monday through Friday
- Ability to lift up to 20 kilograms

Previous supervisory experience is preferred but not required; we provide a paid two-week leadership training program for promising candidates. The position pays $22 per hour, with a $1.50 per hour increase after a successful six-month probationary review. Benefits include dental coverage and ten paid vacation days per year.

To apply, upload a résumé and the contact information of two references through this page by July 8. Interviews will be conducted during the week of July 13. No phone inquiries, please.

Please note: group rates are not offered on the first weekend of August during the Gull Island Regatta, and reserved seating cannot be guaranteed for bookings made under the ten-day deadline. Final passenger counts may be reduced by up to 10 percent without penalty until 48 hours before departure; larger reductions are charged at the full group rate.
